scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rent/shared && npm run build -w @rent/api && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @rent/api" "npm run dev -w @rent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rent/shared && npm run build -w @rent/api && npm run build -w @rent/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rent/shared && npm run build -w @rent/api && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests docs README.md playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests docs README.md playwright.config.ts
